texts.NIV84: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth--and not I only, but also all who know the truth--
texts.KJV: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
texts.NKJV:
The Elder,
To the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all those who have known the truth,
texts.NASB95: The elder to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not only I, but also all who know the truth,
texts.DRB: The ancient to the lady Elect, and her children, whom I love in the truth, and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth,
texts.ESV: The elder to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all who know the truth,

texts.NIV84: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:
texts.KJV: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
texts.NKJV: because of the truth which abides in us and will be with us forever:
texts.NASB95: for the sake of the truth which abides in us and will be with us forever:
texts.DRB: For the sake of the truth which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
texts.ESV: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:

texts.NIV84: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, will be with us in truth and love.
texts.KJV: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
texts.NKJV: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with you from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
texts.NASB95: Grace, mercy and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
texts.DRB: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace from God the Father, and from Christ Jesus the Son of the Father; in truth and charity.
texts.ESV: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from Jesus Christ the Father's Son, in truth and love.

texts.NIV84: It has given me great joy to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
texts.KJV: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
texts.NKJV: I rejoiced greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, as we received commandment from the Father.
texts.NASB95: I was very glad to find some of your children walking in truth, just as we have received commandment to do from the Father.
texts.DRB: I was exceeding glad, that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
texts.ESV: I rejoiced greatly to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as we were commanded by the Father.

texts.NIV84: And now, dear lady, I am not writing you a new command but one we have had from the beginning. I ask that we love one another.
texts.KJV: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
texts.NKJV: And now I plead with you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment to you, but that which we have had from the beginning: that we love one another.
texts.NASB95: Now I ask you, lady, not as though I were writing to you a new commandment, but the one which we have had from the beginning, that we love one another.
texts.DRB: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as writing a new commandment to thee, but that which we have had from the beginning, that we love one another.
texts.ESV: And now I ask you, dear lady—not as though I were writing you a new commandment, but the one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.

texts.NIV84: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands. As you have heard from the beginning, his command is that you walk in love.
texts.KJV: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
texts.NKJV: This is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, that as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.
texts.NASB95: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you have heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
texts.DRB: And this is charity, that we walk according to his commandments. For this is the commandment, that, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in the same:
texts.ESV: And this is love, that we walk according to his commandments; this is the commandment, just as you have heard from the beginning, so that you should walk in it.

texts.NIV84: Many deceivers, who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh, have gone out into the world. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
texts.KJV: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
texts.NKJV: For many deceivers have gone out into the world who do not confess Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
texts.NASB95: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
texts.DRB: For many seducers are gone out into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh: this is a seducer and an antichrist.
texts.ESV: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Such a one is the deceiver and the antichrist.

texts.NIV84: Watch out that you do not lose what you have worked for, but that you may be rewarded fully.
texts.KJV: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
texts.NKJV: Look to yourselves, that we do not lose those things we worked for, but that we may receive a full reward.
texts.NASB95: Watch yourselves, that you do not lose what we have accomplished, but that you may receive a full reward.
texts.DRB: Look to yourselves, that you lose not the things which you have wrought: but that you may receive a full reward.
texts.ESV: Watch yourselves, so that you may not lose what we have worked for, but may win a full reward.

texts.NIV84: Anyone who runs ahead and does not continue in the teaching of Christ does not have God; whoever continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
texts.KJV: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
texts.NKJV: Whoever transgresses and does not abide in the doctrine of Christ does not have God. He who abides in the doctrine of Christ has both the Father and the Son.
texts.NASB95: Anyone who goes too far and does not abide in the teaching of Christ, does not have God; the one who abides in the teaching, he has both the Father and the Son.
texts.DRB: Whosoever revolteth, and continueth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that continueth in the doctrine, the same hath both the Father and the Son.
texts.ESV: Everyone who goes on ahead and does not abide in the teaching of Christ, does not have God. Whoever abides in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

texts.NIV84: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take him into your house or welcome him.
texts.KJV: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
texts.NKJV: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this doctrine, do not receive him into your house nor greet him;
texts.NASB95: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house, and do not give him a greeting;
texts.DRB: If any man come to you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into the house nor say to him, God speed you.
texts.ESV: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house or give him any greeting,

texts.NIV84: I have much to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
texts.KJV: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
texts.NKJV: Having many things to write to you, I did not wish to do so with paper and ink; but I hope to come to you and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
texts.NASB95: Though I have many things to write to you, I do not want to do so with paper and ink; but I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that your joy may be made full.
texts.DRB: Having more things to write unto you, I would not by paper and ink: for I hope that I shall be with you, and speak face to face: that your joy may be full.
texts.ESV: Though I have much to write to you, I would rather not use paper and ink. Instead I hope to come to you and talk face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

texts.NIV84: The children of your chosen sister send their greetings.
texts.KJV: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
texts.NKJV: The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen.
texts.NASB95: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
texts.DRB: The children of thy sister Elect salute thee.
texts.ESV: The children of your elect sister greet you.
